identityAudit.visualIdentity: Short tousled silver-white hair; compact navy insulated parka with pale fur-trimmed hood, cuffs and hem, cream high-neck sweater; dark blue-gray cargo trousers and navy winter boots with pale fur/cream and restrained amber details. Atlas has asymmetric amber sleeve mark on anatomical RIGHT (viewer-left front), dark glove only on anatomical LEFT hand (viewer-right front), and worn harness/straps plus cable-car buckle at anatomical LEFT hip. Atlas pose has hand in pocket and other hand on strap; candidates use empty relaxed hands while preserving worn glove and source strap/buckle placement. No age or gender inference; no held equipment/props invented.
identityAudit.sideMapping: West-facing exact LEFT profile shows anatomical LEFT near; east-facing exact RIGHT profile shows anatomical RIGHT near; north rear view puts anatomical RIGHT on viewer-right and anatomical LEFT on viewer-left.

runtimeCalibration.method: Body bounds are pixels with alpha >=128; origin X is alpha-weighted centroid over the bottom 50 pixels of the body bounds divided by image width; origin Y is the exclusive body-bounds bottom divided by image height; display size is calibrated to 56 world pixels using 56 * image height / body-bounds height.
